snippet.title: 2D Game. 3D food.Wendy’s Made a Retro RPG????
snippet.description: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones an epic 2D role playing game. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & square off against evil mech-monsters, explore culinary kingdoms, and solve tasty puzzles to save Savoria from mechanized destruction.
